# Debt Payoff Skill

This skill turns the debts you list into a payoff plan you can follow. Give each balance, rate, and minimum payment, choose avalanche or snowball, and get a payoff order, a monthly payment plan, and a debt-free date computed from your own numbers, with what-if checks for an extra monthly payment.
